common.tagline: Fog-drowned swamp world strong with the Force — and most spacers can't see why.
common.famousFor: Almost nothing. Survey crews report nav-instruments going odd in low orbit and turn back.
common.cantinaReputation: Swamp world. Dense fog, massive gnarltrees, and aggressive fauna make Dagobah inhospitable to settlement. No cities, no spaceports, no Imperial presence. In 15 BBY, Dagobah is a dead end on the nav charts — a place ships pass over, not through. Sensors read poorly in the atmosphere. A perfect place to disappear, if you could survive.
